Context: This list shows some of the things people need to do or that people need to be in order to become a state police officer in Louisiana.
Title: Source 2: How to Become a Louisiana State Police Officer
Content:
:ibox:• Be a United States citizen.
• Pass some college classes or work in government.
• Be of good moral character¹.
• Pass a written test.
• Pass a physical test.
• Pass an oral interview.
• Successfully complete the State Police Training Academy.
References: be of good moral character: be a person who is honest, helpful, and trustworthy
